transcript.answer: The OpenTelemetry metrics API has no proxy meter, unlike its tracing API. If you create an instrument with `metrics.getMeter()` before a `MeterProvider` is registered, you get a permanent no-op. It stays a no-op even if a provider is registered later. In Lore, `libs/server-core/src/outbound/otel.ts` created its instruments at import time, and the entrypoint imported it before `initOtel()` ran. As a result, lore-api's counters such as `lore.http.requests` and `lore.tool.calls` never recorded anything. The fix (ADR-050, PR #2652) moved the instruments to `libs/shared/src/outbound/otel/metrics.ts`. That file resolves them lazily against whichever global meter provider is registered at record time, memoized per provider.

judgements.reason: The answer states that the metrics API has no proxy meter, that pre-registration instruments stay no-op permanently, and that Lore resolves instruments lazily against the current provider, matching all essentials of the gold answer.
